_mock: MOCK DATA — fictitious hotels, reviews and press for development (Phases 1–2). Not real properties. Generated by scripts/mock/generate-ratehawk-fixtures.mjs.

9990000001.text: We were greeted warmly as a same-sex couple and the staff recommended great queer bars nearby.
Lovely garden views. The inclusion policy is printed in every room — small thing, but it mattered to us.
Rooms are small but beautiful. Breakfast could be better.
Named one of Saigon's most welcoming small hotels for LGBTQ+ travellers.

9990000002.text: Fine for a short stay. Nothing special.

9990000003.text: We were asked whether we were married before we could get our double room. Uncomfortable.

9990000004.text: Receptionist rolled his eyes when we asked for one bed instead of two. Apartment itself was great.
Felt watched at the front desk when my boyfriend and I came back late. Not sure if it was just us.
Spacious, well equipped, would stay again.

9990000006.text: The owners made us feel at home. Perfect base for Pride week.
Rooftop is stunning, and the hosts are part of the local community.
Profile of the couple who restored the building and opened it to queer travellers.

9990000007.text: Great pool, busy in summer. Staff were professional.
Good location near the river. No issues as a gay couple.

9990000008.text: Charming but the stairs are a workout.

9990000009.text: Nice garden. Some staff seemed cold.
Two guests filed a complaint alleging they were refused a shared room; the hotel said it was a booking error.

9990000010.text: Self check-in was easy. The registration form asked for gender, which was awkward for my non-binary partner.

9990000011.text: Clean apartment, great river view. Staff were polite and kept to themselves.

9990000012.text: We stayed as a lesbian couple and were treated like family. The pool is lovely.
Staff remembered our names and recommended inclusive bars nearby.
